==> README.md <==
# Docker Compose deployment

Run `docker compose up --build` from this directory. The hub starts first; every segment registers its compiled contract and waits for all handlers to be ready.

Configure images, runtime settings, and published ports in the web composer Deploy tab. Review the generated files, then download a new bundle after changes. Runtime images must provide the libraries needed by their executables.

Each segment takes its roster from the hub when it starts: the loaded instances of every segment, at least `min_replicas` of each (one by default). An instance that starts later joins: once it is ready, the segments already running route to it, so `docker compose up --scale <segment>=N` adds instances. Scaling works only for a segment that publishes no host port: two containers cannot bind one port. An instance that is stopped retires: the others stop routing to it, and it leaves once it has drained. Kubernetes and srt-slurm are not generated.

This bundle builds local sources: its images build from a context outside the bundle, which holds every crate it builds from by path. It builds only on the machine that wrote it, and every change to those crates rebuilds its images.

==> compose.yaml <==
{
  "services": {
    "hub": {
      "build": {
        "context": "../..",
        "dockerfile": "target/gdl-local-golden/hub/Dockerfile"
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "2s",
        "retries": 30,
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck"
        ],
        "timeout": "2s"
      }
    },
    "main": {
      "build": {
        "context": "../..",
        "dockerfile": "target/gdl-local-golden/main/Dockerfile"
      },
      "depends_on": {
        "hub": {
          "condition": "service_healthy"
        }
      },
      "healthcheck": {
        "interval": "5s",
        "retries": 3,
        "start_period": "1800s",
        "test": [
          "CMD",
          "/usr/local/bin/segment",
          "--healthcheck",
          "/etc/gdl/config"
        ],
        "timeout": "3s"
      },
      "init": true,
      "ports": [],
      "stop_grace_period": "630s"
    }
  },
  "x-gdl-local-sources": "This bundle builds local sources: its images build from a context outside the bundle, which holds every crate it builds from by path. It builds only on the machine that wrote it, and every change to those crates rebuilds its images."
}
==> contract/Cargo.toml <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.

[package]
name = "http-contract"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false

[dependencies]
gdl-runtime = { path = "../../../crates/gdl-runtime" }
http-frontend = { path = "../../../examples/http" }

# Its own workspace, though a workspace may hold the bundle.
[workspace]

==> hub/Dockerfile <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit
FROM rust:1.93.1-slim-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build
RUN cargo install --path '/app/crates/gdl-hub' --locked --root /build-tools gdl-hub
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /build-tools/bin/gdl-hub /usr/local/bin/segment
COPY ["./target/gdl-local-golden/deployment.json", "/etc/gdl/config"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/segment","/etc/gdl/config"]

==> hub/Dockerfile.dockerignore <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit
# What the build context leaves out: build output and git history.
**/target
**/.git
!target/gdl-local-golden

==> main/Cargo.toml <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit.
# Regenerate with: cargo gdl compose --local --spec "../../../examples/http/gdl.toml" --out <directory>

[package]
name = "http-main"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2024"
publish = false
rust-version = "1.93"

[lib]
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "http-main"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
gdl-runtime = { path = "../../../crates/gdl-runtime", features = ["hub"] }
http-contract = { path = "../contract" }
http-frontend = { path = "../../../examples/http" }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["io-std", "io-util", "macros"] }
toml = "0.9"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["env-filter", "fmt"] }

# Its own workspace, though a workspace may hold the bundle.
[workspace]

==> main/Dockerfile <==
# @generated by gdl-gen; do not edit
FROM rust:1.93.1-slim-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app
ENV CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/build
RUN cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path '/app/target/gdl-local-golden/main/Cargo.toml'
FROM gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12:nonroot
COPY --from=build /build/release/http-main /usr/local/bin/segment
COPY ["./target/gdl-local-golden/main/config.toml", "/etc/gdl/config"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/segment","/etc/gdl/config"]
